text: dsh-atomgit 是面向 DSH Web 的 AtomGit 集成插件。它注册六个按需调用的 AtomGit 技能，并通过 bundle 接入 AtomGit 托管的 MCP 服务，同时提供共享鉴权服务。主要能力包括规划并整理仓库 Issue、实现 Issue 并准备 PR、审查与合并 PR，以及镜像 AtomGit 仓库到 GitHub和管理 CLI 发布流程。适合希望在 DSH 中完成 AtomGit 仓库协作的开发者。使用前需要 AtomGit 账号和 ag CLI 登录凭据；令牌默认读取本机 ag 凭据文件，也可用 ATOMGIT_TOKEN 覆盖。

dsh-atomgit adds six on-demand AtomGit skills and hosted MCP tools to DSH Web. Use them to plan issues, implement changes and prepare PRs, review or merge PRs, mirror repositories to GitHub, and manage CLI releases. Requires an AtomGit account and ag CLI login.

能不能在 DSH 里从 AtomGit Issue 开始实现需求并准备 PR？
我需要模型帮忙检查一个 AtomGit PR 的改动和讨论。
让 DSH 按流程确认后再合并指定的 AtomGit 拉取请求。
想把 AtomGit 上的主分支和标签同步到 GitHub。
需要按照项目规范测试并发布 AtomGit CLI 新版本，有什么完整步骤？
Help me turn concrete repository gaps into a deduplicated AtomGit issue backlog.
I want to review an AtomGit pull request against its linked issues and current changes.
dsh-atomgit 的功能「Issue 规划」：分析仓库现状并整理可执行、可去重的 AtomGit Issue 草案。通过规划技能触发，输出带范围和验收标准的待办。
dsh-atomgit 的功能「Issue 到 PR」：从指定 AtomGit Issue 梳理验收要求，实施变更并准备关联 PR。通过实现 Issue 技能触发，按工作流产出代码改动和 PR。
dsh-atomgit 的功能「PR 审查与合并」：检查 AtomGit PR 的变更、关联 Issue 和流水线状态，并在明确授权后按选定方式合并。通过对应 PR 技能触发。
dsh-atomgit 的功能「仓库镜像与 CLI 发布」：按限定范围同步 AtomGit 仓库到 GitHub，或完成 AtomGit CLI 的校验、版本准备和发布流程。通过镜像或发布技能触发。
dsh-atomgit 使用前须知：MCP 调用将令牌随授权头发送至 AtomGit 托管服务 api.atomgit.com；需先准备 AtomGit 登录凭据。

dsh-atomgit README · dsh-atomgit：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

AtomGit plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): lets dsh users host and manage code on AtomGit out of the box. One package delivers all three AtomGit services:

dsh-atomgit README · dsh-atomgit：| Layer | Source | Shape in dsh |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Workflow | [atomgit-skills](https://atomgit.com/hust-open-atom-club/atomgit-skills) | Six built-in skills in the model's `<available_skills>` catalog, loaded on demand via the `skill` tool |
| Execution | [atomgit-cli](https://atomgit.com/hust-open-atom-club/atomgit-cli) (`ag`) | The model runs `ag` commands directly through the built-in bash tool |
| Interaction | AtomGit platform-hosted MCP server (`https://api.atomgit.com/mcp-server/v1/mcp`) | Native tools `mcp__atomgit__*` bridged by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` over streamable-http; no local server to run |

dsh-atomgit README · dsh-atomgit：Built-in skills (vendored from the atomgit-skills upstream): `atomgit-plan-issues`, `atomgit-implement-issue`, `atomgit-review-pr`, `atomgit-merge-pr`, `atomgit-publish-cli-release`, `atomgit-mirror-to-github`.

dsh-atomgit README · Installation：Prerequisites — **one authentication step covers all three modules**:

```sh

dsh-atomgit README · `ag auth login` stores the AtomGit PAT at ~/.config/ag-cli/token.json.：npm install -g @hust-open-atom-club/atomgit-cli
ag auth login
```

That's it. No separate token setup for the MCP endpoint or the skills.
section: `ag auth login` stores the AtomGit PAT at ~/.config/ag-cli/token.json.

text:
dsh-atomgit README · Authentication (unified)：All three modules share **one AtomGit PAT** — the same credential `ag auth login` obtains (its OAuth token *is* a PAT):

| Module | How it authenticates |
| --- | --- |
| `ag` CLI / skills | Read `~/.config/ag-cli/token.json` directly |
| MCP endpoint (`mcp__atomgit__*`) | The plugin's `atomgitAuth` service resolves the token from the same ag credential file and sends it as `Authorization: Bearer <PAT>`; no user setup |

dsh-atomgit README · Authentication (unified)：Optional override: to use a different token (e.g. a manually created PAT from AtomGit → Settings → Access tokens), set `ATOMGIT_TOKEN` in the `.env` of the dsh working directory — the plugin falls back to it when the ag credential file is absent.

Install the bundle (run from the directory containing this package):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-atomgit

dsh-atomgit README · or from a remote: dsh plugin --profile web add github:you/dsh-atomgit#<sha>：dsh web
```
section: or from a remote: dsh plugin --profile web add github:you/dsh-atomgit#<sha>

dsh-atomgit README · What the model gets：After startup the model side automatically gains:

- Six `atomgit-*` skills in the `<available_skills>` catalog, loaded on demand via the `skill` tool; `references/` files (e.g. `ag-commands.md`) are read on demand through the directory resource hint.
- Native `mcp__atomgit__*` tools (repos / branches / issues / PRs / search) from the AtomGit platform-hosted MCP server — no local server, Docker, or Python install needed.
- `ag` in bash (`ag repo view`, `ag pr list`, `ag issue create`, …).

dsh-atomgit README · What the model gets：Typical workflow: `atomgit-plan-issues` to plan issues → `atomgit-implement-issue` to implement and open a PR → `atomgit-review-pr` to review → `atomgit-merge-pr` to merge after your explicit authorization.

```yaml

dsh-atomgit README · Disable the MCP server entirely (skills + ag only):：- id: mcp-atomgit
  disabled: true

  inject: [atomgitAuth]
  config:
    serverName: atomgit
    transport: streamable-http
    url: https://your-host/mcp
    headers:
      Authorization: !!js '`Bearer ${ctx.atomgitAuth.token ?? ""}`'
```

dsh-atomgit README · Syncing skills：`skills/` is vendored from the atomgit-skills upstream pinned to a tag, keeping "plugin version ↔ skill version" reproducible:

```sh
npm run sync-skills            # sync main
npm run sync-skills -- v1.2.3  # sync a specific tag
```
